title: Mazungumzo Mahususi (Theme 5: Unyanyasaji wa kijinsia)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the time, the group and the state of the person, then chooses the greeting or farewell and its reply.

floor.prerequisite: Greets for the time of day.
floor.question: Asubuhi tunasema?

steps: Give or expect the right reply.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child acts three greetings with their replies.

misconceptions.ask: Salamu hii hujibiwa kwa maneno gani?

misconceptions.repair: Salamu hufuata wakati: jioni ni "Habari za jioni".

misconceptions.ask: Rafiki yako yuko katika hali gani?
Mtu huyu ni mkubwa kwako au rika lako?
misconceptions.repair: Shikamoo ni kwa mkubwa; mwenzako husalimiwa "Hujambo".
